note: Six sites beside the playground in the village park just south of the US 8 / US 63 roundabout, entered from Maple Street North; pay at the kiosk. The dump station is on the west side along Pine Street North. The park restrooms open about April 15 to October 15. --Claude
summary: Village page and campsite map read: $25 a night confirmed, 6 W/E sites, FCFS, 7-night limit, dump on Pine St, no showers. Not waterfront kept. Google 4.3 (196; the listing is the whole park).
